name: Otter AI

findings.api_breadth: Official MCP supports meeting/transcript search, fetch and user information with user-authorized access. A separate Enterprise Public API retrieves channels, conversations, transcripts/audio, action items, insights, outlines and workspace details; documented webhooks support export integrations.

evidence.title: Otter MCP Server
evidence.excerpt: Otter hosts an OAuth MCP for authorized meeting data; ChatGPT tools are search, fetch and get-user-info. Its MCP FAQ does not offer a generic public MCP API key.

evidence.title: Otter.ai Public API
evidence.excerpt: The separate Public API is available to Enterprise workspaces, uses bearer API keys, and retrieves meeting/workspace data with rate limits and webhooks.

evidence.title: Otter Pricing
evidence.excerpt: Basic Free includes Otter MCP; API and Webhooks are listed under custom-priced Enterprise.

notes: The MCP FAQ's lack of a public MCP key does not mean Otter lacks a REST API. Free MCP availability is explicitly priced, while direct Public API entitlement is Enterprise. No free personal bearer API was inferred or executed; no account was created.

name: Grain

auth_methods: personal bearer access token (REST and MCP)
findings.api_breadth: Public API reads/manages meeting recordings, transcripts/notes, uploads, metadata/sharing and webhooks. MCP is personal-scope meeting/search/reporting and contact/company data; Deals and coaching tools require Business/Enterprise, and workspace-scope tokens are not accepted by MCP.

evidence.title: Grain Authentication
evidence.excerpt: Grain documents personal, workspace and OAuth bearer tokens; workspace tokens require admins/eligible plans, and only personal-scope tokens authenticate MCP.

evidence.title: Grain API
evidence.excerpt: The dedicated API help page explicitly permits Personal API on every plan including Free; Workspace API requires Business/Enterprise and admin access. It describes recording read/write and webhooks.

evidence.title: Grain MCP FAQ
evidence.excerpt: Grain officially supports MCP on Free/Starter for most meeting tools; Deals and coaching are restricted to Business/Enterprise.

evidence.title: Grain MCP Tools
evidence.excerpt: The MCP inventory identifies Free/Starter meeting search, transcript/notes fetching and participant/company lookup; premium reporting tools are separate.

notes: Free personal REST access is independently supported by a dedicated API article, not inferred from MCP documentation. Older generic Plans documentation/search snippets said Free excluded API access; the newer specific API help and current auth distinctions are more precise. No live credential issuance was tested. API docs use a newer version header than older help examples, so implement against the current developer version reference.
